tasks.analysis: Many smartphones have a built-in GPS to determine your position. This GPS technology is often referred to as a global positioning system, which calculates your coordinates using two values, latitude and longitude. Both values represent angles that you form between your position, the center of the Earth, and a baseline. 许多智能手机都内置了全球定位系统（GPS）来确定你的位置。这种 GPS 技术通常被称为全球定位系统，它通过纬度和经度这两个数值来计算你的坐标。这两个数值均代表你所在的位置、地球中心与一条基准线之间形成的角度。
